# MERP-UI 2.0.6 — Lightweight Characters & On-Demand Lore

This release consolidates the Foundry-tested improvements to RMU character creation and reference reading.

### What's new

- **Race, Culture and Profession reference buttons.** Read full descriptions directly from the MERP-RMU Compendiums, in French or English and for the applicable Age. Reference text is fetched only when needed and is not duplicated in the character.
- **Compact literary reader.** PragRoman, dark ink on parchment, and reduced text sizes aligned with the RMU character sheet. The buttons appear below the character header, not among Foundry's window controls.
- **Culture Skills improvements.** Retain the scroll position when assigning cultural skill ranks, and make RMU's native **All / Choices / Assigned** selector more legible.
- **Lightweight newly created Actors.** Embedded Races, Cultures and Professions no longer carry the complete historical `compendiumAgeVariants` or bilingual `compendiumLocalizations` payloads. The automatic Hildor initial Race is covered. RMU mechanical data, chosen Age, technical keys and Compendium references are preserved.
- **All nine permanent LevelDB Compendiums are retained**, complete with the original bilingual reference material. No World Journals, Scenes, existing Actors or game rules are altered by automatic migration.

### Validation

Author-tested in **Foundry V14.370** with **Rolemaster Unified (RMU) 1.4.99**, including the GATES LIGHT test World. A new Elves (Quendi) / Noldor / Bard character was checked: all three embedded identity Items had neither Age variants nor copied localization metadata. Six automated compaction tests and source/ZIP integrity checks are included in this release pipeline.

### Important distinction for older Worlds

The preventative fix applies to newly created or newly imported Actor identities. It **does not automatically compact existing Actors**. For a World that previously accumulated large embedded Race flags, preserve a full backup and migrate that World separately. Do **not** delete the Compendiums or the stored bilingual descriptions.

### Installation

Install or update from the Foundry manifest:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blackbiji/merp-ui/main/module.json`

For a manual installation, use the complete `merp-ui-2.0.6.zip` attached to this GitHub Release, **not** a small experimental patch ZIP. The archive includes all nine Compendiums.

MERP-UI is an unofficial, free, non-commercial fan project for Foundry VTT and RMU. See `NOTICE.md` for third-party rights and font licences.
